name: dsers-mcp-product
description: Automate DSers product import from AliExpress/Alibaba/Accio to Shopify & Wix using AI
long_description: An MCP server that lets AI agents automate the entire DSers dropshipping workflow. Paste a product link from AliExpress, Alibaba, or Accio.com — your AI agent imports it, applies pricing rules, cleans up the title, and pushes it to your Shopify or Wix store. Supports bulk import, multi-store push, SEO optimization, and pre-push safety checks.

tools.description: Set whether a product shows up in your store or stays as a hidden draft

tools.description: Push products to Shopify or Wix — single, bulk, or all stores at once

tools.name: dsers.job.status
